summary.text: Rebecca Kislak is a Democratic state representative who has represented District 4 in the Rhode Island House of Representatives since January 1, 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: In the 2021-2022 legislative session Kislak was assigned to the House Education Committee, the Municipal Government Committee and the Special Legislation Committee.
